mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank intervention expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumer credit (RSAFS) signal broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 5-day returns with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), higher rates compress equity valuations and slow growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payrolls growth consistently supports corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production decline below 100.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profit visibility and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO remains below 100.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic deceleration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through recession fears.
failure_condition: Joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative 5-day returns with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a housing starts decline exceeding 0.5% in one month signals peak demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as growth expectations reverse.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines > 0.5% in 1 month.
